about: The offertory antiphon of the First Sunday of Advent, Psalm 24:1–3 in the Vulgate numbering (Psalm 25 in Hebrew). These are the verses the introit sang, and the typical edition begins them here Ad te, Dómine, levávi where the introit begins Ad te levávi.

s01.translation: To You, O Lord, I lift up my soul. O my God, in You I trust. Let me not be put to shame, nor let my enemies mock me, for none who await You shall be put to shame.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

w013.note: The ending -am is future indicative and present subjunctive at once. This edition takes the subjunctive and marks the doubt.
w013.explanation: Present subjunctive in a petition: the psalmist asks not to be put to shame. The Hebrew volitive form and Greek optative confirm this reading.
